name: zendesk
title: Zendesk
description: Zendesk Support connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's Zendesk tickets as `zendesk:ticket` items in the local index — the subject, the plain-text description (the first comment), status (new/open/pending/hold/solved/closed), priority, type, requester/assignee/group/organization ids, tags, and the originating via-channel. Useful for correlating customer support history with code/PR changes ("which tickets reference the checkout regression?") without leaving Nimbus. HTTP Basic auth: the username is `<email>/token` and the password is the API token (`Authorization: Basic base64(<email>/token:<api_token>)`; never logged). Zendesk is per-tenant: the user supplies the full base URL `https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com` via the `zendesk.url` vault key, and that host is added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddZendeskMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. Zendesk cursor-paginates `/api/v2/tickets.json` (`page[size]=100`), following `meta.after_cursor` while `meta.has_more` is true. `created_at` / `updated_at` are ISO-8601 (converted to epoch-ms on index). v1 indexes tickets only — comments, users, organizations, and Help Center articles are deferred follow-ups; reply/solve/assign HITL writes are deferred.

tools.name: zendesk_list
tools.description: List the user's Zendesk tickets (`GET /api/v2/tickets.json?page[size]=100`). Returns the cursor-pagination envelope `{ tickets: [...], meta: { has_more, after_cursor }, links: { next } }` — `tickets` holds the ticket objects.

tools.name: zendesk_get
tools.description: Fetch one Zendesk ticket by its numeric id (`GET /api/v2/tickets/{id}.json`). Returns the `{ ticket: {...} }` envelope. Throws when no match is found.

tools.name: zendesk_search
tools.description: Substring search across the user's Zendesk tickets (first page only). Matches the query against the ticket subject, description, status, priority, type, and tags (case-insensitive). Returns a `{ matches: [...] }` envelope.
